pages.title: Nucleosynthesis Chamber
pages.text: Takes a star through its whole life - collapse, ignition, giant phase, death - and keeps the elements it forges.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.

Almost every atom heavier than helium in my body was cooked inside a star. This chamber runs that process on a workbench: a gas cloud falls in on itself, fusion lights, the star swells, and it dies. My notes on stellar evolution follow each stage.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 3 fluid inputs, 2 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Gold Ingot, Primordial Nucleosynthesis Ash, Protostar Core, R-Process Cluster, Red Giant Envelope, Stellar Core, Stellar Iron Ingot, Stellar Plasma, White Dwarf Core.
